title: Herbal Creamy Greek Egg Pilaf
description: A creamy and savory Greek dish featuring summer savory and eggs, perfect for a midnight craving. This ovo-vegetarian friendly pilaf is infused with the aroma of wok-hei and the freshness of herbs.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the dried summer savory leaves and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the uncooked rice to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
While the rice is cooking, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
When the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the egg mixture.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the eggs are cooked through and the mixture is creamy.
Stir in the crumbly feta cheese and cook until it is melted and well combined.
